content.text: The public sanity check passes. I’ve also checked 2,000 small random epochs against exhaustive schedule enumeration, including verification of every circulation bound, residual inequality, and infeasibility cut. Next I’ll test larger cases and malformed inputs through the bounded runner.

python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/submission/planner.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('from heapq import heappop, heappush\n','from heapq import heappop, heappush\nimport sys\n\n# Residual augmenting paths can visit the full finite network.\nsys.setrecursionlimit(10000)\n')
s=s.replace('''        reached = net.reachable(source)
        # A failed flow has cut capacity below the total demand, and hence no
        # nonbinding tree arc can leave this cut. Intersecting it with the
        # public nodes is therefore a valid public-network lower-bound cut.
        return False, [node for node in range(self.K) if reached[node]]
''','''        # The compressed network is used only for feasibility decisions.
        # A public-coordinate cut is computed separately after the search.
        return False, None
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat > /workspace/tmp/large_test.py <<'PY'
exec(open('/workspace/tmp/test_planner.py').read().split('random.seed(10)')[0])
random.seed(1234)
for mode in range(10):
    S=256;J=512;F=32;G=32
    slots=[[s*3900000000,random.randrange(0,5),0 if s==0 else random.randrange(0,3)] for s in range(S)]
    if mode in (0,1,2):slots=[[t,1,0 if s==0 else 2] for s,(t,c,r) in enumerate(slots)]
    groups=[[random.randrange(-1,g),512 if mode<6 else random.randrange(20)] for g in range(G)]
    flows=[[random.randrange(1,65),512,random.randrange(-1,G),0] for f in range(F)]
    windows=[]
    for j in range(J):
        a=random.randrange(S) if mode%3 else 0
        b=random.randrange(a,S) if mode%3 else S-1
        windows.append([random.randrange(F),slots[a][0],slots[b][0],1,1,0,1,[]])
    case={'bucket':[50,50], 'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}
    thr=[65535]*J;values=[random.randrange(1,1000001) for _ in range(J)]
    start=time.monotonic()
    result=plan(case,thr,values)
    opttime=time.monotonic()-start
    check(case,thr,values,result)
    print(mode, 'time',round(opttime,3), 'ratio',result['ratio'],'selected',sum(s>=0 for s in result['assignment']), 'arcs',len(result['flow']),flush=True)
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B tmp/large_test.py
